name: Collapsing Ice
disable: 2 DC 19 Crafting check to create a makeshift device to brace the ice.

items.name: Collapse
items.text:
Trigger A creature follows the false trail onto thin ice

---

Effect The ice collapses beneath the lead dog sled team. The dogs and sled can be rescued, but the PCs lose significant time.

text: The ice here is weak and collapses under the weight of a Small or larger creature.
